The first attached images show 'Chibi Fujie' (ちびフジィ), a cute chrome-silver sturgeon mascot, and its expression sheet. The last attached image shows the SHEET LAYOUT STYLE to copy. Reproduce Chibi Fujie with total consistency in every panel: polished chrome-silver body, pale silver belly, long flat pointed snout, four barbel whiskers under the snout, row of rounded scute bumps along the back, one large glossy black eye with a white catchlight, crescent tail, bold dark navy outline, flat cel shading with crisp white highlights.

Create a JAPANESE LINE STICKER SHEET: a 5-column by 4-row grid of 20 separate stickers on a pure white background. Each sticker is a full-body or upper-body pose of the character with a thick white sticker die-cut border around it, drawn in bright, bold, expressive Japanese sticker art style with small cartoon effect marks (sparkles, sweat drops, motion lines, hearts). Each sticker includes its Japanese caption text rendered in a chunky rounded bold Japanese font with a white outline, placed beside or below the character. Render the Japanese characters accurately and legibly. Generous white space between stickers.
